2350-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Stone Calendar, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1580-4616-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4616-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Moldervine Reclamation and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

6103-6105-8095.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, causing you to choose how players vote this turn and drawing a card.
Cast Magister of Worth by paying {4}{W}{B}.
When Magister of Worth enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Magister of Worth and any number of other creatures.
Resolve the Magister of Worth trigger, having each player vote for grace, returning all creatures from graveyards to the battlefield.
Resolve all abilities from step 4.
Repeat from 3.

3899-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

1624-2927.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Plunge into Darkness by paying {1}{B}, choosing its second mode and causing you to pay all but 1 of your life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

275-3375-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2034-2906-4871-7147-7817.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
2034-2906-4871-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Rakdos.
Repeat.

339-677-4050-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4377-5531-7715.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
4377-5531-7715.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons for its buyback cost by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Blink Lumra using The Mighty Thor.
When Lumra enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-4485-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration
1618-2440-4485-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4485-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Docent of Perfection // Final Iteration. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

1394-2060-3062-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Pir.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Pir.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

224-5627-7201.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-5627-7201.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sapling Nursery and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Repeat.

104-2034-5086-5183-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-2034-5086-5183-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

232-1235-2493-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1770-6754-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-6754-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-6754-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2301-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

2173-2324-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2781-5987-6798.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2428-3591-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2428-3591-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

2653-4365-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2653-4365-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2653-4365-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

277-5175-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-5175-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-3230.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Coral Atoll.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Coral Atoll.
Repeat.
74-943-3230.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Coral Atoll instead.

1563-2457-2837-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

317-2438-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
317-2438-3197.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

539-3932-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to green is at least four.
539-3932-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Hope Tender's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and exerting it, untapping Hope Tender and Nykthos.
Repeat.

222-586-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-586-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2579-4050-4215.notablePrerequisites: You control and own a green nontoken creature.
2579-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any color.
The Cauldron of Eternity and Verdant Succession both trigger.
Resolve The Cauldron of Eternity trigger first, putting the creature on the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning the creature to the battlefield.
Repeat.

700-4971.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
700-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat.
Break the loop by damaging a different target with Niv-Mizzet.

1518-1987-3448-4125.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3448-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
